lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice reformulating healthcare appointment information into clear everyday Swedish.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Understanding a vårdcentral message about booking, cancellation, and waiting times.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining instructions from a source and checking what action is needed.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a message from a vårdcentral and reformulate the instructions so the next step is clear.

main_focus.name: instruction reformulation with man ska and man behöver
main_focus.description: Turn source instructions into practical action statements using impersonal man and modal verbs.
model_examples: Man ska avboka tiden senast dagen innan.
Man behöver logga in med e-legitimation för att boka om.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use impersonal instruction reformulation naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: passive forms like tiden bokas om

useful_chunks: Man behöver boka om tiden om...
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use healthcare-service words without turning the lesson into medical advice.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person has received a healthcare message and is unsure about the next step.
dialogue_shape.middle: They reformulate two instructions, mention a condition, and clarify timing.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide which action should be done first.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat man ska and man behöver in practical instructions

focus: the purpose of the healthcare message
the condition that affects the appointment
the first action that needs to be taken

sentence_focus: one sentence with man ska for an instruction
one sentence with man behöver for an action
one sentence explaining a condition with om
one sentence stating which step comes first
